tx_pending_after_submission.meaning: the submitted transaction remains pending (not mined immediately) because of insufficient gas

tx_executed_after_deadline.meaning: the pending transaction is executed at a later time, after its intended deadline, without a proper deadline bound
tx_executed_after_deadline.checkpoint: at later execution of the pending transaction

claims.scope: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange calls Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager with block.timestamp as deadline

preconditions.text: A transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately, leaving it pending.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The deadline passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should bound the time within which the transaction may execute, so a transaction cannot be executed after its intended deadline.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Without a proper deadline, pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The deadline argument is intended to bound the time within which the transaction may execute, per the security intent.
The pending transaction is the one submitted by the original submitter to increaseLiquidityCurrentRange.

limitations: Impacts are described as possible (potential modality); the plan encodes the forbidden later-execution occurrence, not a concrete incident.
No numeric deadline bound is available, so temporal ordering is captured qualitatively via a grounded Boolean.
